- **Proposed order**: phase 6 -- the big bets, in dependency order

---
**@dezren39 · 2026-09-30T12:12:01Z**

**Issues pass (2026-09-30, at 05c78b2).**

- Added `Parent: #181`, a footer (Ease L, Impact med-high) and Related links.
- Applied known correction 5. The `$` row said the core "must already be binary-free (#44)". #53 closed #44: the plugin uses the unix socket and spawns `mcpx --json status` only as rung 4, the last fallback (`plugin/opencode/README.md:83-110`, `daemon.ts`). `Depends on: #44` is now marked closed.
- Recorded #171's effect. `TestThePluginReadsNoUndeclaredSetting` scans all of `plugin/**/*.ts(x)`, so a v2 port is covered and any variable it honours must be declared in `internal/settings/plugin.go`. Also noted the dead `permission.ask` hook (`docs/declared-but-unread.md`).
- The opencode-side line references were not re-checked (upstream repo). "No real choice." Added the `implement` label.


---
**@dezren39 · 2026-10-28T20:40:37Z**

Triage verdict (lane A, task 2037, 2026-10-28): **CONFIRMED at current HEAD — a rewrite, routed code-side; kept open under #181.**

Evidence (owning repo developing-today/code @ bfcfc15ac; the mcpx source left dezren39/nix on 2026-10-19, #468):
- `pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx-session.ts:737` still hooks the v1 API: `"experimental.chat.system.transform": async (_input, output) => {`.
- `pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/README.md` still describes v1 loading semantics (every `plugin/*.ts` export called as a plugin) and install by copying into `~/.config/opencode/plugin`.
- No v2 shape exists in the plugin: no `{id, setup}` export, no `session.hook("context")` — the port has not happened.

Routing: no follow-up packet from this triage. This is explicitly a rewrite, not a `small_fix`, and the code lives in developing-today/code; backlog re-homing is tracked by developing-today/code#309 (OPEN). No counterpart for #47 exists there yet, so #47 stays open under tracker #181 until the re-home lands; the v1→v2 mapping table in this issue body is the spec for whoever picks it up there.

- **Dedupe (explicit):**
  - **#730 is NOT a duplicate.** Its workstream 2 ports the fleet's *deployed copy* at `.opencode/plugin/mcpx-session.ts` (repo config, under the opencode migration tracker) — a different artifact from the *shipped product plugin* at `pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/` that this issue covers. Both need doing; neither subsumes the other. A cross-note is posted on #730 so the two ports share one shape instead of diverging.
  - **#1932 already owns** the server-side half of this issue's "Also" paragraph (`_meta["ai.opencode/sessionID"]` session attribution) — excluded from the follow-up packet.
  - **#1861** (harness-free plugin core + adapters) is the substrate the v2 adapter sits on, not a duplicate; **#1855** is the plugin *docs* pages.
- **Scope check against current main `82b019a0` (2026-10-29, via GitHub API):** the shipped plugin is still purely v1 — `pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx-session.ts` imports `{ tool, type Plugin }` from `@opencode-ai/plugin`, exports a single default, and hides helpers in the `mcpx/` subdirectory precisely because the v1 loader globs `plugin/*.ts` (its own header comment) — the idiom this issue says v2 abolishes. No v2 tree exists. The daemon core it must reuse (`mcpx/daemon.ts`, `ops.gen.ts`) is present, and the settings guard (`TestThePluginReadsNoUndeclaredSetting` over `plugin/**/*.ts(x)`) will cover a v2 tree automatically, as the issue records. One caution carried into the packet: this issue's opencode-side line references were taken against opencode's `v2` branch and never re-checked — the implementer verifies v2 API facts against the pinned v2 in `docs/opencode-plugin.md` (reports 2.0.3) and the migration guide, not against those refs.
- **Routing — core now, wins as remainder:** implementation follow-up enqueued as queue task **3068** (packet `hidden_files/packet-1858-fix.json`), scoped to the core rewrite: `{id, setup}` shape, session-environment API, context hook, namespaced `tool.transform` registration, status-union `tool.execute.after`, `ctx.storage` remembered daemon, v1 plugin untouched beside it.
- **SET-REMAINDER (owed after 3068 lands; enqueue then, do not file per-piece issues):** the v2-only wins that sit on the core — sampling answers via `ctx.generate.text`, `mcp.transform` filtered per-session registration, `permission.hook("evaluate")`, promise-based TUI `select()` daemon picker. All four are specified in this issue's table.

- **What it records:** every v2 fact the rewrite depends on, re-checked against the **pinned** v2 source rather than the `v2` branch this issue cited. Two corrections to the mapping table above:
  1. The session-environment route is `PUT /api/session/:sessionID/environment` (`protocol/src/groups/session.ts:879`), not `/api/experimental/...`.
  2. **It replaces, it does not merge.** `core/src/session/environment.ts` overwrites the per-session map and `core/src/shell.ts:262` reads `environments.get(sessionID) ?? process.env` — so a plugin sending only `MCPX_*` would strip `PATH`/`HOME` from every shell command in that session. The adapter must send the full environment.
- Also confirmed: only `default` is read and `{id, setup}` is one of exactly two accepted shapes (`core/src/plugin/module.ts:107-134`); `tool.execute.after` is a real `status` union, so failures are recordable; `ctx.storage` covers the remembered-daemon file; `plugin/opencode/mcpx/daemon.ts` needs no rewrite (socket-first, harness-free).
